diagnosis: The export download retrieval handler stores pre-signed cloud storage URLs in NodeCache and fetches entries solely by req.params.jobId. The endpoint fails to inspect whether exportData.tenantId matches req.user.tenantId. Any authenticated tenant guessing or observing export job IDs can obtain pre-signed URLs to download complete database exports of other tenants.
